convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom indicator (WeightOscillator) which is not a built-in MT5 indicator, requiring custom indicator implementation or porting in Python conversion

other_exits: Close opposite position on signal reversal before opening new position

position_sizing.conditional_logic: If Lots parameter is negative, absolute value is treated as fixed lot size; if positive, it represents the fraction of deposit to risk per trade

custom_logic_notes: EA uses custom WeightOscillator indicator with two buffers (main and signal line). Entry signals are based on crossover of these two buffers on completed bars (shift 1 vs shift 2). Opposite positions are closed before opening new ones on signal reversal. Lot sizing has dual mode: negative values = fixed lots, positive values = deposit fraction.
python_conversion_notes: Must implement or port the WeightOscillator custom indicator logic to Python. The indicator likely computes a weighted combination of multiple moving averages or oscillators. Without the .mqh source, the indicator calculation must be reverse-engineered or obtained separately. Digit adjustment logic for SL/TP (multiplying by 10 for 5-digit brokers) must be handled. The dual lot-sizing mode (negative=fixed, positive=fraction) must be preserved.
